Subject: Invitation to Speak at [Conference Name]

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of [Organization Name] to invite you to be a keynote speaker at our upcoming conference, [Conference Name], scheduled to take place on [Date] at [Location/Virtual Platform].

This year’s conference theme is [Theme], focusing on [brief description of theme]. Given your extensive expertise and thought leadership in [Speaker's Field/Topic], we believe you would be an exceptional fit to inspire our audience of [Number] industry professionals. Your recent work on [Specific Project/Book/Article] particularly resonated with our planning committee, and we feel your insights would add tremendous value to the discussions.

We would be honored to have you deliver a [Duration, e.g., 45-minute] keynote address followed by a [Duration, e.g., 15-minute] Q&A session. In terms of engagement, we are pleased to offer a speaking fee of [Amount], along with coverage of all travel and accommodation expenses.

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to schedule a brief call to discuss the details further at your convenience.

Thank you for considering our invitation. We look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to [Conference Name].

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Organization Name]
[Contact Information]
